note: ORPHAN Pro 31:27 — she looks well to the ways of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.

dims.v: vigilant diligence — watching over her household, never idle

the looking well to the ways of her household and refusing the bread of idleness — the vigilant diligence that oversees all her household's affairs and will not be idle, industry that watches as well as works, the opposite of the sluggard's paralysis
the watchful diligence that oversees the household and never sits idle

atsluth (idleness/sloth), negated — 'she looks well to the ways of her household and does not eat the bread of IDLENESS' (31:27); her diligence is vigilant oversight — she watches over all and is never idle. The very antithesis of the sluggard closes her portrait: industry that both works and watches.
